title: Why Chile is so long, and Bolivia has a navy with no sea
description:
Chile runs 4,270 km north to south but averages only 177 km wide: the Andes fix one side, the Pacific the other, and the north came from a war that left Bolivia without a coast.

Labels: Chile's length is 4,270 km in one source and 'over 4,300 km' in another. Bolivia's navy also patrols rivers, not just Lake Titicaca. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain).
